page.title: App Proxy
page.notice: Apps launched here receive Clash proxy environment variables. Use TUN mode for apps that completely ignore proxy environment variables.
page.argsNotice: Launch arguments can be left empty. When needed, enter them like command-line arguments, for example --incognito or --profile-directory="Profile 1". Wrap values containing spaces in double quotes.

form.name: Name
form.argsHelp: Optional. Separate arguments with spaces and wrap values containing spaces in double quotes.
form.profileHelp: Optional. Used to copy existing bookmarks, extensions, and sign-in state into the proxied browser folder.
form.profileCloneHelp: Close that browser before cloning. The proxied instance uses an independent copy and will not affect your normal browser.

feedback.profileCloned: Browser data cloned into the proxied instance
